title: Art Paper

onscreen_lines.desc: Dual Surface Paper Roll, 36" x 1000', Black (Design Guide: Pacon ArtKraft Duo-Finish #P0067301)
onscreen_lines.note: Dual surface, 36" x 1000' roll: Durable heavyweight paper is acid free and two sided, with a smooth side that’s perfect for felt pens, finger painting and fine line drawing. The other side is a superior, “toothy” surface, perfect for chalk, tempera, water color and acrylic paints. This paper is made with a special process, making it resistant to tears and punctures and excellent for a wide array of art and display projects. Alief ISD# 05-3365. Alief ISD reserves the right to award on an ALL OR NOTHING BASIS.
